raw.title: Employee Relations Advisor - (Contract)
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

 

The Role
We’re scaling rapidly, and as we expand our reach, launch new products, and enter new markets, we need to stay sharp, scalable, and human. That’s where you come in.

We are introducing a newly created People Advisor role on a Fixed-Term Contract. This isn't just about managing a queue of cases; it's a unique project to build a legacy.

We want you to harness modern systems and AI to revolutionize how we manage employee relations, uncover casework insights, and proactively empower our business leaders.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has the curiosity to pioneer AI-driven ways of working, and brings deep experience handling complex, international ER cases.

You'll collaborate closely with our People team across the UK, Barcelona, and Boston. If you want to lead a high-impact project that will meaningfully elevate our people and performance, we’d love to meet you!


What you’ll do

  • Develop and implement next-generation ways of working, utilizing AI integration to streamline case management, data analysis, and manager enablement.

  • Act as a trusted co-pilot to our leaders, empowering them to confidently navigate performance, conduct, probation cases, attendance concerns, and policy changes.

  • Maintain flawless, compliant documentation while providing high-quality, human-centric support that ensures our policies are applied consistently across the region.

  • Transform raw data into strategic insights, highlighting trends and early warning signs so we can intervene proactively rather than reactively.

  • Drive ER cases from open to resolution with exceptional efficiency, minimizing timelines without compromising on care or compliance.

  • Partner seamlessly with the wider People Team and business units to ensure smooth, aligned delivery of all ER matters.

 

What you’ll bring

  • A forward-thinking mindset and tech proficiency: Practical experience using AI tools to drive efficiency, enabling you to successfully embed modern workflows into our daily casework.

  • Exceptional judgement and coaching skills: The ability to balance structured case processes with human nuance, providing co-pilot support that leaves managers feeling confident and empowered.

  • Deep ER expertise and pace: Strong, hands-on experience navigating complex ER, performance, and conduct cases across the UK and Europe, ensuring matters progress swiftly with noticeable reductions in delays.

  • Strategic partnership and data utilization: The ability to build deeply integrated, trusted partnerships across the business, using clear, reliable case data to support planning and mitigate risks.

  • Relentless attention to detail: A highly organized approach guaranteeing an impeccable standard of documentation accuracy and regional compliance.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

raw.title: Director Product Management - Identity & Activation
raw.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

The role

We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. You will own product strategy and roadmap across both identity and activation, bring a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and turn that into products customers want to buy.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate at two altitudes. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. You will play a meaningful part in expanding our client base, which means you understand the market, the buyers, and what it takes to win them.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for identity resolution and activation, and make the prioritization calls that keep the team focused on what matters most.

  • Advance our identity resolution product: graph building and enrichment, cross-device and cross-identifier linking, and interoperability.

  • Own the activation side with equal weight: audience activation, data orchestration, and delivery across a broad and growing set of destinations, including platforms and DSPs, in cloud-native environments.

  • Develop a clear understanding of the market and competitive landscape, and translate it into product positioning and roadmap decisions that expand the client base.

  • Partner directly with customers and commercial teams to understand what they need, and translate commercial requirements into clear, buildable specifications for engineering.

  • Work hands-on with engineering day to day to deliver, unblock decisions quickly, and keep the roadmap moving.

  • Own privacy and data governance considerations across the product, so that identity and activation are built to a privacy-first standard from the start.

  • Define the success metrics for the products you own, and use them to guide investment and iteration.


Who You Are:

 

  • Significant product management experience in AdTech, MarTech, or B2B data platforms, with a track record of owning products end to end.

  • Deep domain expertise in identity resolution and device/identity graphs: how graphs are built, enriched, maintained, and measured.

  • Strong experience in the activation and data movement domain: audience activation, destination integrations, and cloud-native or composable data architectures.

  • A clear, informed point of view on where the identity and activation market is heading, and the commercial judgment to know which customers and use cases to build for.

  • A demonstrated record of helping expand a product's customer base, ideally with platforms, DSPs, media networks, or similar AdTech customers.

  • Proven ability to work directly with customers and commercial teams and translate their requirements into specifications engineering can build against without a long back-and-forth.

  • Hands-on delivery experience: writing specs, prioritizing ruthlessly, and shipping alongside engineering in a fast-moving environment.

  • Comfort setting direction and operating with ambiguity in an early-stage environment.

  • Working knowledge of the privacy and consent landscape and how it shapes data products.

  • Curiosity about how AI is changing product configuration, data discovery, and activation workflows.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact.

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for identity resolution and activation, and make the prioritization calls that keep the team focused on what matters most.

  • Advance our identity resolution product: graph building and enrichment, cross-device and cross-identifier linking, and interoperability.

  • Own the activation side with equal weight: audience activation, data orchestration, and delivery across a broad and growing set of destinations, including platforms and DSPs, in cloud-native environments.

  • Develop a clear understanding of the market and competitive landscape, and translate it into product positioning and roadmap decisions that expand the client base.

  • Partner directly with customers and commercial teams to understand what they need, and translate commercial requirements into clear, buildable specifications for engineering.

  • Work hands-on with engineering day to day to deliver, unblock decisions quickly, and keep the roadmap moving.

  • Own privacy and data governance considerations across the product, so that identity and activation are built to a privacy-first standard from the start.

  • Define the success metrics for the products you own, and use them to guide investment and iteration.


Who You Are:

 

  • Significant product management experience in AdTech, MarTech, or B2B data platforms, with a track record of owning products end to end.

  • Deep domain expertise in identity resolution and device/identity graphs: how graphs are built, enriched, maintained, and measured.

  • Strong experience in the activation and data movement domain: audience activation, destination integrations, and cloud-native or composable data architectures.

  • A clear, informed point of view on where the identity and activation market is heading, and the commercial judgment to know which customers and use cases to build for.

  • A demonstrated record of helping expand a product's customer base, ideally with platforms, DSPs, media networks, or similar AdTech customers.

  • Proven ability to work directly with customers and commercial teams and translate their requirements into specifications engineering can build against without a long back-and-forth.

  • Hands-on delivery experience: writing specs, prioritizing ruthlessly, and shipping alongside engineering in a fast-moving environment.

  • Comfort setting direction and operating with ambiguity in an early-stage environment.

  • Working knowledge of the privacy and consent landscape and how it shapes data products.

  • Curiosity about how AI is changing product configuration, data discovery, and activation workflows.

Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East)
raw.description:
The Opportunity

The infrastructure that runs the modern world (power grids, data centres, fibre networks, EV charging) is being built out faster than at any point in a generation. The companies doing that work are drowning in the volume, variety, and velocity of it. Sitetracker is how they stay ahead of it.
 
Sitetracker is the AI-native platform for infrastructure lifecycle management, covering project, construction, operations, and asset management in one system of record. Scout, our enterprise AI agent platform, is what sets us apart. Scout does the work, not just reports on it, and it stays grounded in the customer's own data so the answers are trustworthy enough to act on. That is what holds up in an enterprise procurement review when a bolted-on chatbot does not.
 
You will be our go-to Strategic Account Executive for the Middle East territory. Your job is to grow revenue and to shape how Sitetracker leads the AI-native transformation of digital infrastructure across the Middle East. You will own a priority territory with strong product-market fit, backed by proven customer outcomes, a differentiated platform, and strong demand generation.
 
Our top performers work as enterprise advisors. They bring strategic thinking, curiosity, and real customer empathy. They own outcomes, not quotas. If you raise the bar, love winning new logos, and want autonomy, scale, and purpose, this is a role worth a serious look.
 

What You'll Do

You will join a sales team that pairs start-up pace with enterprise ambition. This is a build role, not an inherited book of business. You will define and execute the go-to-market strategy for your territory, engage new prospects, and guide them through high-stakes decisions with precision and insight.
 
Every deal moves the industry forward, whether that is energising a new grid interconnection, standing up a data centre, upgrading a telecom network, or scaling EV charging. You will orchestrate complex buying journeys across large stakeholder groups, partner cross-functionally with product, marketing, and services, and earn the trust of executives on both sides. This is a quota-carrying role in a MEDDPICC environment, and it is also a chance to lead, to sell a genuinely differentiated platform, and to leave a mark.
 
You will be selling into a market that is actively rethinking how it uses AI. Part of the job is separating signal from hype: showing skeptical enterprise buyers what agentic AI grounded in their own operational data actually changes about how their teams work, and what it is worth.
 

The Skills You'll Have

Enterprise Sales

  • Demonstrates evidence of selling in the Middle Eastern markets
  • Strong evidence of success selling complex SaaS solutions across mid-market, large, and enterprise accounts, ideally in Telecom, Energy, or adjacent infrastructure sectors.
  • Can walk through, in detail, how you navigate a complex enterprise SaaS deal to a win and the role you personally play in it.
  • Won high-value SaaS deals ($300k+ ARR) by navigating complex buying centres and influencing executive stakeholders.
  • Knows when to bring in the right partners based on deal strategy.
  • Defines and executes territory plans against a named top-account list, including Sitetracker's priority Middle Eastern accounts under our go-to-market strategy.
  • Executes within MEDDPICC or a comparable methodology, holding rigour and velocity across every cycle.

Consultative Sales

  • Researches effectively: understands how a target company makes money, where it aligns to our value proposition, and who the stakeholders are.
  • Drives the conversation around product and unique value, knows the proof points, and ties platform capability directly to business outcomes.
  • Builds credible business cases and ROI models for prospects, including the economics of AI-driven automation, not just software seats.
  • Plays back the financial impact of the solution and presents commercial offers anchored to that business case.
  • Acts as a challenger and trusted advisor by knowing the customer's industry and business well.

Entrepreneurial Mindset

  • Runs the territory like its CEO. Owns the actions, owns the decisions, and moves with speed and urgency.
  • Builds and sustains a healthy (5x) pipeline and drives opportunities through the full cycle to a win.
  • Leads a cross-functional account team (SDR, SE, Product, Delivery, Legal, CSM) through complex cycles and creates alignment between our team and the customer's.
  • Builds for the long term, focusing on durable deals that last.

Within 90 Days, You'll:
  • Be Sitetracker certified, including a working command of how Scout is positioned and where it wins.
  • Understand Sitetracker's business objectives and strategy.
  • Know your territory and be able to build territory, account, and opportunity strategy.
  • Be developing effective cross-functional relationships across the team.
  • Begin establishing your pipeline and take ownership of existing relationships and accounts.
  • Have command of the Sitetracker message and be able to tell our story to customers and prospects.
  • Run productive meetings that advance opportunities and accounts.

    • Within 180 Days, You'll:
  • Be executing the Sitetracker sales process, including MEDDPICC qualification and documentation.
  • Have exceptional command of the message and the process.
  • Have your territory planned and your pipeline defined.
  • Be actively engaged with customers and prospects and on track to goal.

    • Within 365 Days, You'll:
  • Look back on year one able to take pride in "getting it done" and "doing it right."
  • Have hit your ARR and new-logo goals, delivered with quality, integrity, and respect.
  • Contribute to best practice by spotting improvements and taking the initiative to recommend and implement them.
    • About Sitetracker
     
    Sitetracker was founded ten years ago with the singular focus of solving a problem that was first recognized within the telecommunications industry; how to effectively manage the volume, variety, and velocity of critical infrastructure projects needed to meet the demand of expanding wireless and cellular service.  That problem has become even more pronounced due to the eventual explosion of 5G.  Being able to effectively deploy infrastructure is going to be the differentiator between leading telecommunication providers. 
     
    However, over the years, we realized that this challenge isn’t localized to telecommunications – it’s pervasive nearly everywhere and has reached an inflection point.  Utilities (such as gas and electric services), smart cities, and alternative energy all face similar challenges.  Sitetracker is the only full-lifecycle project management platform suited to support these companies and address these challenges.
     
    We are exceptionally proud of the company we’ve built (we were recently recognized as the #2 place to work in San Francisco, as well as one of the top places to work in the entire United States).  Our people are extraordinary and we’re continuing to invest in our people-first culture.

raw.title: Events Marketing Manager - 12 month FTC
raw.description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Role
This position is a 12 month maternity cover. You will join a high-performing marketing team working cross-functionally to drive brand presence and deliver the event strategy for 2027. Reporting directly to the Marketing Director, you will own our events and outbound activity across the UK, Ireland and European markets (covering the NHS, Private Hospitals and Private Medical Insurers).

This is a versatile, high-impact role spanning strategic planning, hands-on event execution, full lead-lifecycle management via HubSpot, plus agency management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Brand integration: Integrate and launch our brand’s new creative style across all event touchpoints.

  • Strategic Ownership: Lead and execute the end-to-end events strategy across UK, Ireland and international markets, spanning external industry conferences, partner events, webinars and in-house roundtables.

  • Sponsorship Portfolio Management: Seamlessly manage diverse event formats and sponsorship activations - including keynote presentations, expert panel sessions, fireside chats, webinars and exhibition stands.

  • End-to-End Logistics & Operations: Oversee all event operations, merchandise, shipping, couriers and on-site setup. Partner with our new fulfilment agency to streamline supply chain and logistics execution.

  • Content & Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal subject matter experts, commercial leads and senior industry stakeholders to produce compelling speaker briefs, presentation content and messaging that resonates with key audiences (working closely with the Marketing Manager)

  • HubSpot & Lead Lifecycle: Drive lead generation, capture and segment routing using HubSpot. Ensure clean data transfer, pass sales-ready leads to the Commercial team and build nurturing workflows for longer-term pipeline.

  • Integrated Outbound Campaigns: Execute multi-touch outbound and email campaigns alongside events to drive registration, pre-event buzz and post-event momentum.

  • ROI & Analytics: Track, measure and report on campaign and event performance using HubSpot and analytics tools. Continually optimise conversion metrics, cost-per-lead and pipeline impact.

  • Budget & Vendor Management: Build strong relationships with event organisers, vendors and partners while maintaining strict ownership of the agreed event budgets.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Events & Outbound Expertise: Proven track record in an events and outbound marketing role, ideally within regulated B2B health tech, MedTech, digital health or the NHS ecosystem.

  • Lead Management Systems: Hands-on experience using HubSpot (or equivalent CRM/Marketing Automation tools) to manage lead capture, pipeline scoring, routing to sales and campaign attribution.

  • End-to-End Delivery: Demonstrated experience handling multi-format sponsorships (booths, panels, speaking slots, webinars) and managing event operations, merch, and fulfilment agency relationships.

  • Stakeholder & Content Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief executive speakers, engage senior clinicians and write persuasive campaign copy.

  • Data-Driven & Organised: Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple concurrent event timelines and making data-backed decisions to demonstrate ROI.

  • Compliance Awareness: Strong understanding of GDPR and data privacy standards in customer acquisition.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience within the NHS, UK healthcare sector or European healthcare markets.

  • Hands-on familiarity with content design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma) or web platforms (WordPress).

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company

🏥 Private healthcare

💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options

🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays

👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster

🐣 Yellownest Salary Sacrifice Nursery Scheme - save with workplace nursery scheme

🚲 Bike to work scheme

💻 Training budget

🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development

🎊 Lots of fun social activities!

Our Values

🌱 Building a Strong Foundation

🎓 Always Learning

🏅 Lead from the Front

💪 Tough and Resilient

The Real Stuff

Skin Analytics embraces and is committed to diversity and equal opportunities. We are dedicated to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. If you need any adjustments during our hiring process, you can indicate that at the next step.

AI usage in our hiring process
If you submit an application to us, you will consent to AI playing a role in your hiring process. No hiring decision is ever made by an algorithm alone. Every AI-generated summary, screening result, or note is reviewed, verified, and, if necessary, corrected by a member of our recruitment team. Humans make the final call on who moves forward and who receives an offer.

You can find more information about how we use AI in our hiring process here.

raw.title: Account Director (DACH)
raw.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

As an Account Director at Snyk, you'll own the end-to-end sales and success cycle for prospective and existing Enterprise customers focused on Digital Transformation. You'll work directly with senior leaders across Security and Engineering organizations, using your territory knowledge and market connections to grow your account base and help embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle.

About the Team

You'll join a sales team that is resilient, business savvy, and curious. We see the value our product offers and want it to be part of every software development process.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for large Enterprise customers, including prospecting, selling, and retaining customers.

  • Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders and C-Level Executives within Security and Engineering organizations.

  • Develop complex account plans that incorporate multiple lines of business, channel ecosystems, and executive coverage models to build a dual-speed business of smaller, faster-moving accounts and larger, more complex accounts.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with leadership, customer success, channel partners, marketing, product, and finance to drive deals and ensure customer success.

  • Manage renewal and expansion for your customer base, ensuring long-term outcomes and partnership growth.

  • Forecast with accuracy and detail for both short and long-term opportunities while proactively mitigating close-lost rates.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant Enterprise Sales Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience owning the entire sales cycle for a technical product on Enterprise level accounts (Fortune 1000).

  • Proven Track Record: You are self-motivated and hard-working, with a history of exceeding your quota and closing million-dollar+ ARR transactions.

  • Domain Expertise: You've excelled at selling into Cybersecurity, DevOps, or DevSecOps groups, or have significant enterprise software sales experience generating and closing large and complex transactions.

  • Strategic Collaboration: You leverage your ecosystem internally and externally, understanding that selling is a team sport at Snyk where managing virtual resources is a must-have skill.

  • Executive Presence: You practice extreme ownership, are skilled in navigating complex organizations, and can engage confidently with C-Level Executives.

  • Consultative Approach: You have strong consultation skills to work with multiple levels within a customer organization to address business challenges.

  • It'd be awesome if you also bring fresh ideas and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo, love solving complex problems with a collaborative team, and have a sense of humour. We take our mission seriously, but not ourselves!

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. This team oversees the entire user journey on Spotify and ensures we engage with people in innovative ways, every step of the way. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
 
As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
 
We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.

What You'll Do
  • Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys.
  • Collaborate with our squad and key internal partners to determine how to design scalable backend systems, data models and APIs that run on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Be a technical leader, mentor and valued contributor in an autonomous, cross-functional agile squad, in close collaboration with other squads and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities.

    • Who You Are
  • You have 5+ years of working experience as a Backend Engineer working with Java. Additional tools and technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery and Bigtable are a plus.
  • You have strong computer science fundamentals and previous experience building complex backend services at scale.
  • You have experience in designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components on providers such as GCP, AWS, etc.
  • You have experience working directly with stakeholders to understand, document and develop APIs and systems to meet their requirements.
  • You are comfortable working collaboratively on cross-functional teams and independently driving complex delivery initiatives.
  • You have written distributed, high-volume services and know how to deploy and operate them in production.
  • You have a growth mindset and are passionate about your work, striving towards the team’s goals and, ultimately, the Spotify Mission.
  • Nice-to-haves: Experience modelling, building and operating integrations with external CMS solutions or working with ML teams for recommendations and data pipelines.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

raw.description:
Director, Legal - Projects & Transactions, EMEA

Location: London, United Kingdom

Role Summary

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of STACK's EMEA data centre development and investment activity. As Director, Legal - Projects & Transactions, EMEA, you will be embedded with the teams shaping and delivering projects across the region, providing strategic and hands-on legal advice from the earliest opportunity assessment through acquisition, development, construction, leasing and operation. You will play a key role in negotiating significant construction and project agreements, structuring complex transactions, managing legal and commercial risk and providing practical solutions to support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead legal support across STACK's EMEA development and investment portfolio, from early opportunity assessment and due diligence through acquisition, development, construction, leasing and operation.

• Be a trusted legal business partner to Development, Construction, Power, Commercial and Finance, engaging early in projects and transactions to shape structure, risk allocation and practical solutions that support business objectives.

• Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of significant construction and project agreements with contractors, suppliers and vendors, including construction contracts, professional services agreements and frameworks, with a focus on appropriate risk allocation and commercial outcomes. Also advise on SPAs, joint venture and development agreements, PPAs and other power arrangements, easements and land rights, and commercial leases.

• Shape and develop STACK's EMEA contracting strategy through standard forms, contracting positions, precedents, negotiation guidance and other tools that make delivery more consistent and efficient.

• Instruct and manage external counsel across EMEA where local law or specialist advice is required, ensuring advice is practical, timely and commercially focused while managing scope, quality and legal spend.

• Provide pragmatic advice on wider commercial, corporate and operational matters, identify and escalate material risks, and help strengthen legal processes and ways of working as the EMEA business develops.

What You'll Bring

• Qualified to practise law in the UK or an equivalent European jurisdiction.

• Significant post-qualification experience advising on complex project and transactional matters, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both; experience partnering directly with construction or project delivery teams is important.

• Strong legal experience supporting the construction and delivery of major infrastructure, engineering, energy, real estate development or other complex capital projects. Experience of data centre construction is particularly welcome; IT services or technology contracting experience alone is not sufficient.

• Strong drafting and negotiation skills, with personal ownership of substantial, high-value contracts and the ability to manage commercial and legal risk over long project lifecycles.

• Commercially minded, with sound judgement and the ability to assess legal and commercial risk, focus on what matters and give clear, actionable advice.

• Experience working across multiple EMEA jurisdictions and coordinating external or local counsel where required.

• Able to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and project teams, influence across functions and jurisdictions, take ownership of matters and manage changing priorities independently, balancing legal rigour with the need to keep projects moving.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work on critical infrastructure that supports the digital economy.

• The chance to build your career with STACK Infrastructure in a high-growth data centre environment.

• Competitive benefits aligned with STACK's UK policies.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world’s most innovative companies, designing, developing, and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty, and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.

For more information about STACK, please visit: www.stackinfra.com

raw.title: Senior Finance Business Partner
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world's most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and high growth environment, join us and be part of a team that's transforming the way the world pays.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity for an experienced finance business partner to join our Commercial Finance team, based in our London office. You will own the COGS profit and loss line (bank fees and hosting costs) and the unit economics across the cost base, partnering closely with Banking, Infrastructure and Engineering to control and improve margins. You will lead monthly performance commentary and the annual planning process for the cost base, working closely with Accounting and the wider business.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • COGS & Unit Economics: Own the COGS P&L line end to end (bank fees and hosting costs) and the unit economics across the cost base, including cost per transaction, feeding into merchant pricing models and investment cases.

  • Banking Partnerships: Partner with the VP Banking Relationships on banking partnerships, driving down banking costs and identifying bank routing efficiencies, including modelling the aggregator versus direct integration breakeven.

  • Cloud Economics: Partner with the VP Infrastructure on cloud cost analysis, ensuring infrastructure spend scales efficiently with usage.

  • Engineering Partnership: Partner with the VP Engineering on capacity allocation and capitalised development project decisions, day to day rather than at a distance.

  • Performance Commentary: Own monthly performance commentary on COGS, working with Accounting to confirm reported numbers are accurate and with the business to understand what is driving the trajectory.

  • Annual Planning: Lead the annual planning process for the cost base, including banking negotiation support, bank routing efficiencies and cloud or hosting optimisation as key initiatives, then support the business through the year to track performance against plan and course correct.

  • Investment decision support: Build business cases for high impact initiatives, which could include new products, regulatory permission changes in key markets, particularly in Europe, and support new product development with ad hoc financial analysis.

QUALIFICATIONS

The successful candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or a similar finance business partnering role;

  • Strong stakeholder management experience, comfortable partnering with finance and non finance teams, including engineering, banking and infrastructure partners;

  • Strong analytical capability, with experience building financial models and business cases;

  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for modelling and analysis;

  • Experience improving processes and ways of working, including bringing automation into finance reporting or planning, is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.

Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong, a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work.

OUR FANTASTIC BENEFITS

  • 25 days of holiday to support a healthy work life balance;

  • Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues;

  • Parental leave top up, additional support for new parents;

  • Daily breakfast and on site perks to make your workday smoother;

  • Wellbeing support, our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages and much more to help you feel your best;

  • PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work life experience!

SHAPE YOUR ROLE AND MAKE AN IMPACT

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change and continuously embrace new challenges. We're looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

raw.title: Treasury Analyst
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Trustly is leading the human centric payments revolution. To us, this means passionately building the most convenient, intelligent and responsible way of paying for things online. Whether it's for shopping, paying subscriptions, funding trading accounts, booking airfare, playing online games and much more, we're all about a better way to pay. At our core, we are a tech company with industry leading tech capabilities. But it's the ingenuity of our people that makes us leaders in our field. Thus, our appetite for innovation will never be anything less than fierce. Trustly is steadily growing as it connects thousands of businesses with hundreds of millions of people. And with a strong presence across Europe and the Americas, we are leading the human centric payment revolution as a truly global team.

This role sits in the Group Treasury team, part of the Group Internal Finance team at Trustly, which also includes Controllers, Tax, Payroll, Finance Operations and Finance Systems. The team is dynamic and cross jurisdictional, with an ethos of collaboration and continuous improvement at its heart.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a newly created role within a growing, newly established Group Treasury function, offering fantastic development and career growth opportunities. You will support the Group Treasury Director across cash forecasting, daily cash management, banking and FX. You will own the group cash flow forecast: working with regional finance teams to improve accuracy, understanding what drives cash movements and reporting key findings. You will also help improve treasury processes, tools and controls as the function expands, with implementation and project based work being a key component of the role.

Key Responsibilities:

Cash Forecasting & Liquidity:

  • Maintain the group cash flow forecast model. Collect inputs from regional business units, investigate variances against actuals and explain the drivers;

  • Run daily cash management, monitor RCF utilisation and produce regular cash balance and liquidity reports;

Banking & Payments:

  • Prepare payments and intercompany transfers in the banking platform for approval;

  • Administer bank portals, including user access, mandates and supporting documentation;

  • Support opening and closing bank accounts and keep banking records accurate;

FX & Money Markets:

  • Assist with FX and money market fund transactions and help monitor FX exposure;

Reporting, Controls & Projects:

  • Prepare and submit quarterly covenants reporting;

  • Identify and deliver improvements in automation, reconciliation and reporting, including bank portals and Atlar as the Treasury Management System (TMS);

  • Help maintain treasury controls and documentation to an audit ready standard;

  • Contribute to treasury projects and ad hoc requests.

Key requirements:

Essential:

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field;

  • Experience in treasury and cash management at a group level;

  • Strong Excel skills, including forecasting, modelling and data analysis;

  • Experience producing or analysing cash flow forecasts;

  • Understanding of liquidity management, banking operations in various regions (US/EU/UK) and treasury controls;

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence working with colleagues across regions and with banks;

  • Self driven and proactive mindset, with the confidence to operate independently and on a standalone basis.

Desirable:

  • ACT, ACCA, CIMA or ACA, or part qualified;

  • Experience with an ERP, a TMS and multi bank platforms;

  • Interest in automation or AI tools for treasury work.

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

Compensation: £55K – £65K

  • • £55K – £65K

raw.title: Head of Product Marketing Management  (London)
raw.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. 

We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

Our values ✨

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

UpSlide is a productivity platform for Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel and Word) built for financial professionals in investment banking, private equity, asset management and advisory. Product Marketing sits at the centre of Product, Sales and Marketing: we decide how UpSlide is positioned, priced and sold.

You'll join as our Head of Product Marketing, reporting directly to Matteo Bordin, our Chief Product Officer.

You'll manage one PMM and over time grow your team.

Day-to-day, you'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leadership. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and still get into the work.

Team goals 🎯

Product Marketing's job is to make UpSlide easy to understand, easy to sell, and priced right. Concretely, that means:

  • Sharpen positioning and messaging so prospects grasp the value fast.

  • Arm Sales to win, especially against direct competitors.

  • Own pricing and packaging decisions and the reasoning behind them.

  • Run customer communications that drive adoption and expansion.

The impact on the business is direct: higher win rates, stronger pricing power, shorter sales cycles.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Positioning & narrative (25%)

  • Own UpSlide's positioning and messaging across segments and personas.

  • Turn product capabilities into a clear story that resonates with financial professionals.

  • Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials and campaigns.

Sales enablement & competitive intelligence (25%)

  • Build the enablement that helps Sales qualify, pitch and close: decks, battlecards, objection handling and one-pagers.

  • Own competitive intelligence: track competitors, brief the business, keep our differentiation sharp.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on win/loss analysis and act on what it tells you.

Pricing & packaging (20%)

  • Own pricing and packaging: structure, tiers, and the logic behind them.

  • Run the analysis and make clear recommendations to the exec team.

  • Support Sales on deal-level pricing and commercial strategy.

Customer communications (15%)

  • Own how we communicate with customers: launches, releases and lifecycle comms.

  • Drive adoption and expansion through clear, well-timed messaging.

Team leadership (15%)

  • Lead, coach, and grow the PMM you’ll manage.

  • Set priorities and hold a high bar on output.

Your goals ⚡

First 3 months: Learn the product, customers and competitors in depth. Build relationships with Sales and Product. Audit our current positioning, pricing and enablement, and tell us where the gaps are.

By 6 months: Ship a refreshed positioning and messaging framework. Stand up a repeatable competitive intelligence rhythm. Deliver a first pricing and packaging recommendation.

By 9 months: Have an enablement program running that measurably improves win rates, pricing changes live or in flight, and a customer communications cadence the business relies on.

As UpSlide grows, this role can grow into broader marketing leadership. We'll back you to get there.


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise B2B sales: you've either carried a quota in complex, high-value deals or worked hand in hand with sellers who do. This is a must.

  • A proven product marketing track record: positioning, messaging and sales enablement that moved the needle.

  • Experience owning or heavily influencing pricing and packaging decisions.

  • People leadership experience: you've managed and developed marketers.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and the judgement to write for an exec audience.

We'd love it if:

  • You've worked in or sold to financial services: investment banking, private equity, asset management, or advisory.

  • You know the Microsoft 365 / productivity software space.

  • You speak French (not mandatory)

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  • First screening with our Talent Acquisition team (30 to 45 min, phone or video): mutual fit and motivation.

  • Manager interview with Matteo Bordin, CPO (45 min to 1h30, video or in person): product thinking and experience.

  • Peer interview with a peer from Product, Marketing, and Sales (~45 min).

  • Case study with Matteo and a Product peer (45 min to 1h30): a deeper problem worked through together.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: An inspiring eighth-floor corner office near Liverpool Street with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a balcony with a view, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: 3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

⏰ Flexi-work: Flex your schedule however works (e.g. bank hours across the fortnight to take a Friday off)

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: £45 per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈ Holidays: 25 days plus public holidays & a half-day of additional holiday per year of full service (up to 5 additional days)

🪙 Pension: Pension contributions (with matched contributions up to 5% after one year)

🩺 Health insurance: Opportunity to opt into a health insurance plan (Vitality)

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

Senior Client Partner (New Business)
raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Client Partner for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from our London or Edinburgh office 2 days a week 

As a Senior Client Partner (New Business), you are accountable for identifying, shaping, and closing net-new client relationships to grow Waracle’s client portfolio. You will work closely with our wider demand, technology, product, design, and delivery teams to originate and win new opportunities.

Whilst this role presents an opportunity to think strategically, build teams, and flex commercial and operational muscles, ultimate success will be measured in net-new revenue terms. This is a hands-on, quota-carrying role. You will personally lead and contribute to pitches and proposals, direct cross-functional pursuit teams, and proactively generate demand through outbound prospecting, partner channels, referrals, events, and networking. You will cultivate strong relationships with senior enterprise client stakeholders, positioning Waracle effectively to help solve their digital and commercial challenges.

Each pursuit is supported by a cross-functional deal team spanning Delivery, Technology, Product, and Design specialists. You will lead these teams through the pursuit cycle, aligning subject matter experts to craft compelling propositions and deliver winning bids.

You’ll join a very high-functioning and successful demand team spanning client growth, new business, and marketing. It’s a small, cross-functional team. Whilst everybody has a clear mission, people are expected to collaborate, support each other, and when required step into each other’s domains.


Key aspects of the role include

• Driving Demand & Strategic Outreach: Collaborating on campaigns, VIP pursuits, and partnership channels to open doors and credibly position Waracle as a trusted digital partner.
• Uncovering & Shaping Opportunities: Taking a thoughtful, proactive approach to understanding client needs, qualifying prospects, and building momentum through meaningful dialogue.
• Leading Pitches & Proposals: Crafting end-to-end proposal narratives and commercial offers, and acting as a confident, engaging lead presenter during client pitches and workshops.
• Cross-Functional Team Leadership: Directing and inspiring multidisciplinary deal teams across Delivery, Technology, Product, and Design to craft winning propositions.
• Nurturing Executive Relationships: Building enduring, trust-based relationships with senior enterprise stakeholders, challenging decision-makers constructively, and expanding our market reach.
• Commercial Stewardship: Optimising margins, designing creative commercial structures, managing pipeline forecasting, and negotiating closing terms with integrity

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box


What you'll bring

  • A proven track record of finding, shaping, and winning new client engagements within a digital technology consultancy or professional services environment.
    • Strong proposal and pitch presentation craft, with a flair for translating complex tech capabilities into engaging narratives and clear commercial value.
    • Outstanding senior stakeholder management skills, with the empathy and confidence to challenge, influence, and build trust with executive decision-makers.
    • Demonstrated experience bringing together and leading cross-functional teams (tech, product, design, delivery) in a supportive, deadline-focused environment.
    • Sound commercial acumen, including pipeline forecasting, margin optimisation, and negotiating win-win commercial agreements.
    • A collaborative, courage-driven mindset—bringing energy, integrity, and conviction to every decision, along with excellent communication skills


What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one


Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

New Business Director [Global]
raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does the New Business Director (Global)  do a WPP Production?

The role

The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.

This is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win consistently across markets and opportunity types.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities — ensuring that every response is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all pitches, setting the standard for how we articulate our value.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.

Key areas of responsibility

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities
  • Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next
  • Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings & pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations
  • Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines
  • Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level
  • Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative and production
  • Able to influence and align senior stakeholders, often with competing priorities, to a single direction
  • Experience shaping or evolving go-to-market propositions and strategic positioning
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges
  • A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact
  • Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact
