raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

raw.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone

Team: Production, Quality

Reports to: VP Production

Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators

About the role

As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents. You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows.

You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content.

We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure.

What you'll do

Quality Agent leadership

  • Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions.

  • Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems.

  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths.

  • Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort.

Research and Product partnership

  • Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows.

  • Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output.

  • Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed.

Audit, compliance and procedure

  • Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits.

  • Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

  • Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work.

  • Make sure quality processes meet customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Customer advisory

  • Partner with Customer Success and Delivery to define proactive quality programmes, success metrics and governance for strategic accounts, including AI-forward enterprise and life science / regulatory programmes.

  • Translate customer quality requirements into clear pre-delivery acceptance criteria, validation methods and risk-appropriate controls.

  • Advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix and where automated, agent-verified, human-verified or combined workflows are appropriate.

  • Represent LILT's quality function as a credible subject-matter authority in customer business reviews, audits and escalations, using quality data and metrics to demonstrate fitness for purpose.

Continuous improvement

  • Lead structured CI across the Commercial business: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, KPI reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own a proactive quality metrics framework that makes errors, PQs, rework and trends visible, and use it to prioritise improvements and demonstrate outcomes.

  • Strengthen quality controls across review, delivery and follow-through, including mandatory account-specific checks, intervention on critical findings and clear escalation ownership.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to automate checks and escalation, and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence rather than ending at rework or ticket closure.

Expert Operations partnership

  • Partner with Expert Supply and Ops to embed processes, guidance and quality feedback that maintain a high-quality pipeline of experts.

  • Use quality findings and recurring failure patterns to improve expert qualification, guidance and ongoing quality management.

Team leadership

  • Lead and develop the Quality team, including the customer-facing Quality Manager and Quality Coordinators.

  • Establish the team's operating cadence and evolve how the team works as Quality Agents reduce manual coordination work.

  • Oversee embedded Quality Manager staffing sold as a service to customers, ensuring the role owns the specific quality programmes and initiatives those customers pay for.

  • Develop playbooks for AI-driven quality management and keep staffing-as-a-service delivery aligned with LILT's quality standards.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Agent design and build: demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and running LLM-based agents in production. Please be ready to walk us through agents you have built.

  • Data-driven quality management: scripting or data skills (e.g. Python, SQL), with experience turning quality data into actionable metrics, preventive controls and measurable improvements.

  • LLM model improvement: proven experience improving LLM output quality.

  • Significant experience running quality systems, including leading audits (internal and external), compliance programmes, and writing and maintaining processes and procedures. Quality certifications such as Six Sigma are a plus.

  • Experience leading structured CI (RCA, CAPA, KPI reviews).

  • Experience managing and developing people.

  • Customer advisory and cross-functional partnership: a clear communicator who can translate customer quality requirements into acceptance criteria and governance, advise on quality, cost and speed trade-offs, and work credibly with customers, executives and technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Background in localisation, translation or language services.

  • Experience in customer-facing quality roles for enterprise accounts.

  • Research and Product collaboration: a track record of working with research scientists and product managers to turn quality insight into product requirements and shipped improvements.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.


🔧 Responsibilities

  • Strategic Advisory: Guide the technical strategy for enterprise sales cycles across EMEA, from initial discovery to closing.

  • Solution Design: Create tailored demonstrations and narratives that align Quantum Metric’s platform with high-level business outcomes.

  • Technical Architecture: Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures and clear value propositions.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives on deal orchestration and coordinate with Product/Engineering to ensure smooth post-sales onboarding.

  • Market Influence: Support RFP responses and provide structured customer feedback to influence the product roadmap.


    • 💡Requirements

  • Linguistic Skills: Proficiency in English and German; additional European languages preferred.

  • Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering within the SaaS or software sector.

  • Sales Acumen: Proven success supporting complex, multi-layered sales cycles for large enterprise organizations.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage both technical teams (architects/developers) and C-suite executives (CIO/CDO).

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and ROI-based solutioning.

  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills tailored for diverse corporate environments.

  • Agility: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple strategic deals and a willingness to travel 25–30% across EMEA.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Digital Experience Analytics or CXM platforms.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, enterprise data architecture, or tagging strategies.

  • Background in high-growth SaaS or digital transformation consulting.

offer.title: Product and Research Operations Manager, Voices

raw.title: Product and Research Operations Manager, Voices
raw.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

The Role

We're looking for a Product and Research Operations Manager to run the operational backbone of Cartesia's Voice function - supporting voice production for customers, talent sourcing and logistics, and voice delivery for Go-To-Market and Customer Success. You'll work directly alongside our Voice Production Lead and Voice Library Lead, and provide hands-on support across their respective work-streams.

Part of your time will go toward cross-functional ad-hoc operations, including supporting growth initiatives.

Your Impact

  • Voice Production & Library - Support execution of voice production runs alongside the Voice Production Lead. Over time, you'll own day-to-day production and library health reporting, take on more locales and volume, and build automations to streamline the process.

  • Sourcing & Talent logistics - Support voice sourcing alongside the Voice Library Lead. Build the systems to source, vet, and create voices for the voice library with voice acting talent as well as vendors.

  • Customer Voice Delivery & Enablement - Own customer-facing voice engagements end to end, driving customers to be successful with our models. Drive voice-related GTM enablement.

  • Ad-hoc Strategy and Growth Projects - Support ad-hoc strategy & operations work, including helping run events and marketing initiatives for Cartesia in London. Support Cartesia’s growth in international markets on a project by project basis.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 - 6 years as an operator at a high-growth tech startup or in strategy consulting (MBB or similar)

  • High agency - a proactive self-starter who can operate autonomously to get things done in ambiguous environments

  • Customer-facing chops, with the ability to drive conversations with executives

  • Semi-technical - comfortable using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, etc to build lightweight systems, and understands core concepts of system design

  • Genuine interest in operating with founder-level hunger, and real enthusiasm for voice and audio technology - you have opinions on it, not just interest

What makes a strong candidate:

  • Experience in the AI industry, especially in AI Strategy and Operations or Product Operations roles

  • A track record of going out of your way to get things done proactively

  • Builds lightweight systems autonomously

  • Detail-oriented under volume; maintains attention to detail even with large volume of tasks

  • Credible in front of GTM teams and customers without needing a lead in the room

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

raw.title: AI Product & Transformation Lead - Legal & Enterprise Risk
raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the role

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a skilled, tech-savvy Legal Operations Specialist to join our fast-paced legal team. As a core member of the department within a leading payment processing company, you will help drive operational excellence, scale our legal tech stack, and streamline workflows.

The ideal candidate helps bridge the gap between legal expertise, technology, and data-driven efficiency. You will be responsible for managing our complex contract ecosystems, optimising team collaboration tools, and leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) to design modern, automated legal processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Legal Tech Stack & Automation Strategy: Support the administration, integration, and continuous improvement of our legal technology tools, with a heavy emphasis on Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems.

  • Atlassian Ecosystem: Support the legal department's Jira infrastructure. This includes assisting with the design, maintenance, and optimisation of workflows in Jira Service Management (JSM) for legal intake, helping manage Jira Spaces, and building out a comprehensive, user-friendly knowledge base in Confluence.

  • AI & Process Engineering: Proactively identify opportunities to embed AI and machine learning tools into everyday legal operations, supporting the development and implementation of AI-driven efficiencies (e.g., automated contract review, AI search optimisation, legal operations chatbots, and automated triaging) to help reduce cycle times.

  • Workflow Optimisation: Evaluate existing legal processes, identify bottlenecks in the payment processing legal pipeline (e.g., merchant agreements, vendor contracts, regulatory tracking), and engineer streamlined, scalable workflows.

  • Data Analytics & Reporting: Design dashboards and generate metrics within Jira and CLM tools to track legal spend, turnaround times, contract volumes, and team capacity. Present actionable insights to legal leadership.

  • Vendor & Resource Support: Help manage relationships with legal tech vendors (e.g. Brightflag) and ensure the team is maximising the value of industry resources (e.g., CLOC, ACC).

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in Legal Operations, ideally within a fintech, payment processing, or highly regulated corporate environment.

raw.description:
Creandum's edge has always been people: the network, the judgment, the hustle. To sharpen our edge, we need to make everything those people learn compound: every meeting, every diligence process, every founder relationship feeding a shared foundation instead of evaporating into inboxes and individual heads.

You will build and own that foundation: the firm's data platform, the intelligence layer on top of it, and the governance that makes partners willing to trust it with their most sensitive work.

This is a new function, and you are its first hire. You'll start hands-on-keyboard and stay that way for the time being; but you're building an estate the firm will run on, and the mandate grows with what you prove.

You report to the Operating Partner, but work directly and independently with every member of the firm.

We believe different viewpoints drive our growth, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

What you'll own

The data platform. The firm's data architecture end to end: warehouse, ingestion from core systems (CRM, meeting transcripts, documents, email/calendar), entity resolution, and data quality. One person, one company, one deal – consistent across every source. This is foundational; everything else flows from it.

The intelligence layer. Retrieval, search & agent tooling that give everyone's AI real firm context, serving both individual workflows (bottom-up) and firm-wide platforms (top-down). Built for passive compounding: the system gets better as people work and as models improve, without depending on anyone's discipline.

Access, trust, and AI risk. The access model as structural enforcement, not instructions: who sees what, with identity, provenance, and audit. Sensitive fund and partner data protected to a standard the partnership will trust, plus the AI-specific risk judgment (injection containment, egress, tool guardrails) for everything the function ships, in collaboration with legal/regulatory counsel.

Technology strategy and the tool estate. Accountability for whether the firm's tools are the right ones: evaluation, integration, and replacement of the systems and data sources the firm runs on, in close partnership with the stakeholders who use them. Buy when buying is better; build when building is better. You have the mandate to choose, and then execute on your decision. Make sure security, compliance and budget are part of the equation.

What you'll deliver

First 6 months. A complete map of the firm's data and systems. The foundational data platform stood up. Two or three lightweight tools shipped that visibly improve how a team works. A clear, prioritized 12–18 month roadmap, authored by you and agreed with the partnership.

By 12 months. V1 of the firm's shared intelligence layer live and in daily use. The diligence process made genuinely multiplayer; firm knowledge and meeting history informing live deals instead of sitting unused. Measurable adoption, reported honestly, with failures killed as quickly as the wins are shipped.

Beyond. The roadmap is yours to define. Candidates for the frontier: productizing how the firm wins deals, network intelligence that answers "who do we know" in seconds, platform tools founders can self-serve, and operational automation across finance, events, and admin.

How you'll work

  • Builder first. You ship personally. This is not a role for someone who wants a team of ten doing the building.

  • Co-creation, not solo genius. Stakeholders across the firm (investment, platform, marketing, operations, etc.) steer, test, and tune what you build. Within a year, everyone at the firm should be able to point at something they had a hand in shaping.

  • Product discipline. Prototype, validate with real users, kill what doesn't get adopted. Usage is the metric; expect and budget for churn.

  • Scale deliberately. You start solo. As the foundation proves out, you'll orchestrate internal or external build resources and potentially grow the function. You are prepared to identify, leverage and lead exceptional talent to help achieve results.

Who you are

  • You've shipped a real data or AI product end to end (pipelines, retrieval, and the product surface) and people actually used it.

  • Deep, hands-on command of data architecture, warehousing, and governance. Fluent with embeddings, retrieval, and agents that act, not just answer.

  • You treat access control and provenance as product features, not compliance chores.

  • Low ego, high agency, energized by a blank page. Excited to tackle the unglamorous work (entity resolution, data hygiene, permissions) that everything depends on.

  • You can sit with an investor, an EA, and a founder in the same week and design for all of them. Venture experience isn't required, but you'll need to earn a front-line view of the work fast.

  • You can say "no" and "not yet" to smart, senior people and make them glad you did.

What this role is not

  • Not IT operations: endpoint, device & office infrastructure are handled by our managed IT partner.

  • Not reg compliance: policy & DORA workstreams are owned by legal, with your input on anything AI.

  • Not a reporting function: you build systems that answer questions, not dashboards on request.

Why this role

You'll have a blank page, real budget influence, direct partnership access, and a firm small enough that what you build touches everyone within weeks. The firms that figure this out will compound differently from the ones that don't. This is the seat where that happens.

raw.description:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Vice President of Sales, EMEA

CreatorIQ is seeking a Vice President of Sales, EMEA to lead our Enterprise Sales team and accelerate our expansion across the EU. Reporting to Brian Atwood, Chief Sales Officer, this leader will be responsible for building net-new enterprise business, expanding strategic customer relationships, and developing a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in London, offering flexibility and the opportunity to play a critical role in scaling CreatorIQ’s enterprise growth across the region.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, creating clear expectations, strong coaching practices, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Build and execute an EMEA enterprise sales strategy focused on net-new customer acquisition, and growth within existing enterprise accounts.

  • Develop a strong, sustainable pipeline and maintain forecasting discipline that improves accuracy, visibility, and predictability across the region.

  • Accelerate enterprise revenue growth by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and helping the team effectively engage C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • Own regional sales performance against quarterly and annual revenue objectives, leveraging qualitative and quantitative data to identify opportunities, risks, and actions necessary to drive results and compress deal cycles.

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with enterprise customers and prospects, serving as a senior commercial partner and trusted advisor throughout the full customer lifecycle.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other cross-functional teams to align go-to-market priorities, support customer growth, and strengthen CreatorIQ’s position in the market.

  • Identify opportunities to expand CreatorIQ’s presence across priority EU markets while staying close to industry trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving customer needs.

  • Uplevel the Enterprise Sales organization by improving sales practices, talent development, operating discipline, and the systems and processes needed to support sustainable growth.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 5+ years of sales leadership experience, with a focus on enterprise sales in a SaaS environment.

  • Proven success leading and developing enterprise sales teams and delivering sustained revenue growth.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and selling to large organizations.

  • Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • A strategic and commercially focused approach, with the ability to translate company growth priorities into clear regional sales plans and execution.

  • A data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, performance measurement, and sales decision-making.

  • Strong proficiency with sales tools and CRM systems, including Salesforce, and a deep understanding of pipeline management and reporting.

  • Sponsors and prioritizes responsible AI adoption, secures needed support and resources, and ensures AI initiatives deliver business value while following governance standards.

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time across EMEA.

  • Experience in marketing technology and/or the creator or influencer marketing industry, and additional European language capabilities such as French or Spanish, are a plus.

  • Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a BI Engineer to join our London team. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

 

About the Role

As a BI Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the models, systems and automation behind our BI platforms. This will include supporting our extensive user base on our current BI stack (primarily Looker and Sigma) while helping shape a single, more integrated BI platform across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own and evolve the semantic layer behind our BI platforms: LookML and Canvas BI models, metric and dimension definitions, and the governance that keeps them trusted

  • Build and operate the Looker and Sigma platforms themselves: instance and workspace configuration, permissions and user attributes, content lifecycle, and API-driven automation

  • Lead the development of self-serve tooling that removes manual BI administration, using usage analytics to decide what to automate, build or retire next

  • Support BI platform migrations and deprecations across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt while protecting access, governance, data integrity and business continuity

  • Take part in operational support, production debugging and incident response for the BI stack, and fix the root causes you find

  • Champion engineering standards in BI, including version control, code review, CI and testing for models and platform code, so changes ship safely and repeatably

We're excited about you because…

  • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar code-first data role

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, and hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) to accelerate your own engineering work

  • Hands-on experience building in a BI platform such as Looker (LookML) or Sigma, modelling and configuring it, not only building dashboards in it

  • Experience with semantic or metrics layers (LookML, dbt or similar): defining metrics and dimensions, and keeping those definitions consistent as they are reused

  • Experience running what you build in production: version control, code review, CI, debugging live issues and taking part in operational support

  • Excellent communication skills, and comfortable self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment with both technical and non-technical teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with modern data warehousing platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift) and ability to optimize performance

  • Experience automating BI administration through platform APIs, or identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls

  • Experience supporting a BI stack across multiple brands, tenants or regions, or leading a BI platform migration

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

As a BI Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the models, systems and automation behind our BI platforms. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems.

While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web.

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). Foster an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture.
  • Platform Architecture & Evolution: Oversee the design and evolution of dynamic layout engines, declarative UI schemas, and client rendering frameworks across iOS, Android, and Web.
  • Developer Velocity & Platform Adoption: Partner with product feature teams to drive internal adoption of Codeless. Ensure the platform provides exceptional Developer Experience, clear tooling, robust design system integration, and seamless debugging workflows.
  • Technical Execution & Quality: Set high technical standards for platform performance, payload optimization, caching strategies, backward compatibility, and graceful offline/fallback behavior across client devices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Design System leaders, and Core Infrastructure engineers to align the Codeless roadmap with broader company initiatives and global design paradigms.

What you'll need to thrive

Engineering Management: 3+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, with a track record of coaching engineers, delivering complex platform initiatives, and driving technical strategy.

UI & Platform Domain Expertise: Strong foundational background in mobile (iOS/Android) or modern web architecture (React, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, or declarative UI paradigms).

Ventures is DoorDash's internal incubator, where we build the next generation of businesses adjacent to our core. We fund small teams with a strong sense of ownership and grow the investment as they hit clear milestones. Early on, teams build a Minimum Lovable Product and prove product-market fit in a single country. Successful initiatives graduate to new resources and new markets, with the chance to become the next billion-euro businesses at DoorDash. Ventures teams are scrappy and ambitious, chase goals that almost feel too ambitious, and thrive on a startup mentality and a high tolerance for ambiguity. We're now placing bigger and more diverse bets than ever, and we need people with equal ambition and drive to build and scale, or sunset, some of our biggest experiments yet.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

As a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls.

As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity.

This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation.

Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation.

  • Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls.

  • Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice.

  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years' experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace).

  • Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products

  • Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP)

  • Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform)

  • Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

  • Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling.

  • Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic.

  • Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance.

  • Ability to write production-quality automation scripts.

  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms.

  • Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance.

  • Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development.

  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC).

raw.title: Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager, Deliveroo Express
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager, Deliveroo Express 

At Deliveroo, our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting customers, restaurants, shops and riders. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

The Team

This role sits within the New Verticals business unit on our Global Strategy, Product and Commercial team, reporting into the Head of Strategic Partnerships, Deliveroo Express with our broader team reporting up into the Director, GM of Drive EMEA and VP of EMEA Markets. We are responsible for setting the strategy and lighting up new verticals, ensuring that Deliveroo has the right to win in the new and highly competitive on-demand Grocery and Retail market. The culture within the  team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. 

The Role

Deliveroo Express is Deliveroo's white-label solution that allows our partners to offer on-demand delivery directly through their own online websites / apps. Imagine going onto your favourite restaurant, grocer or retailers' website and having an order delivered in as little as 20 minutes - from the customer's point of view, you're ordering directly with the restaurant / grocery / retailer, and it's simply delivered by our rapid riders. For more, please see: https://merchants.deliveroo.com/what-we-offer/deliveroo-express

As a Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager in the team, you will manage the day-to-day relationships with our white-label partners, which includes leading regular performance reviews, identifying opportunities for growth and overcoming operational challenges. You will work closely with various functions of Deliveroo to share insights from partners and ensure we are developing a "best in class" value proposition. With Deliveroo Express being a new product launched in April, you will play a pivotal role in defining the on-going strategy and driving success of this proposition. 

Using data to understand trends in performance and identify opportunities for operational excellence will be critical to your success in the role. You will need to be able to manage multiple projects at once, interacting with key functions such as Product, Operations and Commercial. You will use your business acumen and negotiation skills to win new business deals and build an on-going pipeline.

Working with partners of this scale, you will often overcome challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, helping to shape the future of how we work with and scale our white-label partners. 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Directly own the day-day relationship with Deliveroo Express partners across all verticals - Restaurants, Grocery and Retail
  • Analyse and present insights on performance against KPIs during weekly/monthly/quarterly meetings and reviews
  • Conduct detailed analysis and extract insights to deliver operational excellence and identify ways to course-correct if needed
  • Identify opportunities to deepen and grow our partner relationships 
  • Develop on-going sales strategy for Deliveroo Express including pipeline development across markets, with support from your Commercial lead
  • Conduct new business pitching and commercial negotiation for new partners, with support from your Commercial lead

Qualities We're Looking For

  1. DECISIVE AND INFLUENTIAL: ​you should thrive in a fast-paced environment, and be comfortable with making fast decisions, even in times of ambiguity and based on intuition. You are comfortable making recommendations and communicating them across the business persuasively. More importantly, you must have a strong desire to galvanise action within Deliveroo, thinking about the big picture but also not afraid to get into the weeds of a problem to get things done.
  2. ANALYTICAL AND COLLABORATIVE: ​there will be some number-crunching involved, but your role will also be about stepping back – you'll need to see the bigger picture and understand how your insights are aligned with the direction the business is heading in. 
  3. COMMERCIAL: you will need to excel in building relationships with local commercial teams, and external partners and understand how best to bring our proposition to grocers and retailers. You will need to build a deep understanding of the Deliveroo P&L and operations of the business.

 

Requirements:

  • 4-6 years' experience in an account management, grocery/retail operations or strategy / strategic partnerships role. 
  • Confident in analysing data and extracting compelling and actionable insights
  • Strong operational mindset to identify opportunities for excellence and course-correct when needed 
  • Partner obsessed, with effective relationship building, organisation and communication skills
  • Collaborative team player who is able to get the best out of the people around you. Able to work effectively with various teams and all levels of Deliveroo.
  • Experienced negotiator within the ability to drive mutual value for both partners and Deliveroo
  • London-based with a minimum of three days required in the office 

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with FMCG / grocery / retailer e-commerce or last mile operations preferable.
  • Experience in working in a dynamic high-growth company is preferable

We are responsible for setting the strategy and lighting up new verticals, ensuring that Deliveroo has the right to win in the new and highly competitive on-demand Grocery and Retail market. The culture within the  team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. 

The Role

Deliveroo Express is Deliveroo's white-label solution that allows our partners to offer on-demand delivery directly through their own online websites / apps. Imagine going onto your favourite restaurant, grocer or retailers' website and having an order delivered in as little as 20 minutes - from the customer's point of view, you're ordering directly with the restaurant / grocery / retailer, and it's simply delivered by our rapid riders. For more, please see: https://merchants.deliveroo.com/what-we-offer/deliveroo-express

As a Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager in the team, you will manage the day-to-day relationships with our white-label partners, which includes leading regular performance reviews, identifying opportunities for growth and overcoming operational challenges. You will work closely with various functions of Deliveroo to share insights from partners and ensure we are developing a "best in class" value proposition. With Deliveroo Express being a new product launched in April, you will play a pivotal role in defining the on-going strategy and driving success of this proposition. 

Using data to understand trends in performance and identify opportunities for operational excellence will be critical to your success in the role. You will need to be able to manage multiple projects at once, interacting with key functions such as Product, Operations and Commercial. You will use your business acumen and negotiation skills to win new business deals and build an on-going pipeline.

Working with partners of this scale, you will often overcome challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, helping to shape the future of how we work with and scale our white-label partners. 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Directly own the day-day relationship with Deliveroo Express partners across all verticals - Restaurants, Grocery and Retail
  • Analyse and present insights on performance against KPIs during weekly/monthly/quarterly meetings and reviews
  • Conduct detailed analysis and extract insights to deliver operational excellence and identify ways to course-correct if needed
  • Identify opportunities to deepen and grow our partner relationships 
  • Develop on-going sales strategy for Deliveroo Express including pipeline development across markets, with support from your Commercial lead
  • Conduct new business pitching and commercial negotiation for new partners, with support from your Commercial lead

Qualities We're Looking For

  1. DECISIVE AND INFLUENTIAL: ​you should thrive in a fast-paced environment, and be comfortable with making fast decisions, even in times of ambiguity and based on intuition. You are comfortable making recommendations and communicating them across the business persuasively. More importantly, you must have a strong desire to galvanise action within Deliveroo, thinking about the big picture but also not afraid to get into the weeds of a problem to get things done.
  2. ANALYTICAL AND COLLABORATIVE: ​there will be some number-crunching involved, but your role will also be about stepping back – you'll need to see the bigger picture and understand how your insights are aligned with the direction the business is heading in. 
  3. COMMERCIAL: you will need to excel in building relationships with local commercial teams, and external partners and understand how best to bring our proposition to grocers and retailers. You will need to build a deep understanding of the Deliveroo P&L and operations of the business.

 

Requirements:

  • 4-6 years' experience in an account management, grocery/retail operations or strategy / strategic partnerships role. 
  • Confident in analysing data and extracting compelling and actionable insights
  • Strong operational mindset to identify opportunities for excellence and course-correct when needed 
  • Partner obsessed, with effective relationship building, organisation and communication skills
  • Collaborative team player who is able to get the best out of the people around you. Able to work effectively with various teams and all levels of Deliveroo.
  • Experienced negotiator within the ability to drive mutual value for both partners and Deliveroo
  • London-based with a minimum of three days required in the office 

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with FMCG / grocery / retailer e-commerce or last mile operations preferable.
  • Experience in working in a dynamic high-growth company is preferable

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact on your own development, on Deliveroo as we scale, and on the marketplace and communities we serve.

Consumer Ordering Experience owns the core purchase journey: the store page, item page, basket, and checkout flow, across both app and web. It's a global team — the surfaces we build support all of our brands: Deliveroo, Wolt, and Doordash. You'd be the team's first dedicated web/full-stack engineer, helping us build out our web experience from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the store, item, basket, and checkout experiences on web, working primarily in React and TypeScript
  • Contribute to backend services written in Golang — deep Go experience isn't a hard requirement, but you should be comfortable picking up a new statically typed backend language
  • Improve code structure, shape architecture, and review code across the team
  • Partner closely with your Product Manager and fellow engineers to scope and ship changes to the ordering funnel
  • Take part in the hiring process and support the growth of your teammates as the team scales

 

What We're Looking For

Must haves:

  • Strong full-stack experience — comfortable working across web frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go, or similar) to unblock delivery end-to-end
  • Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)
  • Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief PRD through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding
  • Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience coordinating engineers across multiple platforms (iOS/Android/Web/BE) on a single initiative
  • Active use of AI-assisted coding workflows, and interest in building reusable tooling/skills for the team

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to join our Ventures team in London. You'll be the senior design voice on an early-stage product, taking it from first concept to a test-market launch and shaping it for global scale.

About Ventures

Ventures is DoorDash's internal incubator, where we build the next generation of businesses adjacent to our core. We fund small teams with a strong sense of ownership and grow the investment as they hit clear milestones. Early on, teams build a Minimum Lovable Product and prove product-market fit in a single country. Successful initiatives graduate to new resources and new markets, with the chance to become the next billion-euro businesses at DoorDash. Ventures teams are scrappy and ambitious, chase goals that almost feel too ambitious, and thrive on a startup mentality and a high tolerance for ambiguity. We're now placing bigger and more diverse bets than ever, and we need people with equal ambition and drive to build and scale, or sunset, some of our biggest experiments yet.

What You'll Be Doing

Direction & Influence

  • Set the design direction for a new product, turning customer and business inputs into a clear point of view and roadmap, deciding what to build.
  • Become an expert on local market needs, shaping the experience around how customers and partners behave in each place.
  • Partner with product, engineering, operations and commercial leaders as a trusted advisor who shapes the roadmap.
  • Build like a founder: shape success metrics, share weekly updates and present at key business reviews.

Craft & Delivery

  • Build a differentiated experience that competes with the best in a crowded market where customer expectations are high.
  • Design a scalable foundation for complex journeys such as payments, onboarding and matching supply with demand.
  • Turn regulation into design, working with legal, finance and operations to make complex constraints feel simple.
  • Raise the craft bar by mentoring designers, hosting critiques and building reusable systems and AI-assisted tools.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 0-1 Ownership: Proven experience taking at least one product from 0-1, across a new product, market or startup.
  • Craft Mastery: A portfolio of high-fidelity, shipped work that moved measurable outcomes.
  • Product Thinking: You balance customer needs, business goals and feasibility, and frame ambiguous problems.
  • Bias for Action: You'd rather ship and learn than polish in isolation.
  • Systems and AI Fluency: You design reusable systems, prototype with AI and coach peers to do the same.
  • Strategic Influence: You mentor designers and win over partners with differing priorities.

raw.title: Account Executive - Outbound
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 £30,000 - £35,000 + £8,400 OTE + Benefits

Our Account Executive role is the first step in your career within Sales @ Funding Circle! Here you will learn the foundations of sales and account management starting with a tailored two week Sales Induction Programme on joining. From there, you will be given the on-going tools and support to thrive in your role and eventually progress into more senior roles such as Account Manager, Business Development Executive all the way through to Sales Team Manager!

Our Account Executive roles are phone based and are the first point of contact with our Borrowers; speaking with them frequently during their Funding Circle journey. Every day you will speak to a diverse range of SME business owners to gain an understanding of their business, find out about their goals and explain how Funding Circle can help in achieving them.

  • Working with warm leads to generate new opportunities through business development of existing Funding Circle borrowers (c.60-80 dials per day)

  • Establishing instant rapport with your customers via telephone & email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Pitching the Funding Circle proposition against alternative funding options available

  • Managing a high-volume, fast-paced pipeline; supporting your clients through each stage of creating an application

  • Being responsible for your own monthly target and continuously developing & improving your approach to help you get there

  • Proactively problem solving, identifying and confidently mitigating any risks, issues or control weaknesses that arise in your day-to-day

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Experience working in a sales or service environment - we don’t require heaps of experience but some exposure to a sales or service environment is beneficial

  • A strong communicator, confident to be able to engage with small business owners over the phone and via email

  • You’re able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

  • Ability to continually develop and maintain your pipeline whilst managing applications in progress Proactivity and a desire to develop your career and taking onboard feedback - continuous development is a key part of sales at Funding Circle and we are looking for people keen to grow!

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

Enterprise Risk Manager

We are looking for an Enterprise Risk Manager to join our team, with the main focus being on oversight, governance, and driving the strategic execution of Enterprise Risk management framework. Given the lean nature of the team, you will have significant autonomy, wide exposure across the business, and the opportunity to lead, influence, and shape our risk capability as we scale.

The role

  • Lead and provide expert advice & counsel on complex enterprise and operational risk-related matters across the business.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across key functions to identify, evaluate, challenge, and manage key risks and controls.

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across the organisation to drive strategic risk initiatives, build risk maturity, and foster a strong risk culture.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of core elements of the Enterprise Risk Management framework, including KRIs, RCSAs, Operational Risk Event Management, and risk committee management.

  • Drive continuous improvement and scalability of our Risk Governance tools (GRC software) and framework processes.

  • Oversee, prepare, and present high-quality, impactful risk reporting for relevant Executive committees and Board documentation.

  • Provide guidance, coaching, and direction to team members (including Risk Analysts/Senior Analysts) to support their development and drive team outcomes.

  • Track and challenge risk actions, ensuring business owners have appropriate guidance to resolve root causes within agreed target dates.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven, deep experience in Enterprise or Operational Risk Management within financial services, risk consultancies, or Big 4 environments.

  • Experience in SME lending, fintech, or fast-paced digital lending environments is highly desirable.

  • Typically 5+ years of relevant work experience in Enterprise or Operational Risk Management, with demonstrated progression into managerial or senior advisory responsibilities.

  • Strong strategic acumen, problem-solving, and analytical skills with the ability to translate complex risk concepts into clear business impacts.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills—capable of influencing and constructively challenging senior management.

  • Curiosity, good judgement, ability to break down problems and imagine solutions. Enthusiasm about AI and its potential to support the role.
